name: Sabyasachi Bisoi/ ସବ୍ୟସାଚୀ ବିଷୋୟୀ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sabyasachi Bisoi writes poetry and essays in Odia and is associated with Kantamal in Nabarangpur district. In a 2023 interview, he described the difficulty of finding his own surroundings reflected in school literature as an early impulse to write. His essays explore the lives, languages and cultural traditions of the undivided Koraput region.

In ‘କ୍ଷେତର ଅରଣ୍ୟ ରୋଦନ’, a field becomes a living body threatened by the city's expansion. Chains, walls and towers mark successive stages of its destruction; the argument then moves from land to rice, hunger and human survival. The poem questions the cost of development through an intimate feeling of injury rather than an abstract landscape.
